question:
Select the number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following series.

65, 90, 107, 116, 121, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference of the difference between terms is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a0ab8302e8ecc11a38f7ad03644824143b1cb83c7f94b7cf606ab4842b25e73.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **option 1)**
